sloka: न क्रुध्यत्यभिशस्तोऽपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन् ।कृद्धान् प्रसादयन् सर्वान् स इतोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-२०-४॥
transliteration: na krudhyatyabhiśasto'pi krodhanīyāni varjayan ।kṛddhān prasādayan sarvān sa ito'dya pravatsyati ॥2-20-4॥

translations.english: Rama who used to avoid deeds that caused anger, pacified those who were angry with him, and never lost his cool even when cursed, that Rama is going on exile today.
